question: After a card has been exiled with a hideaway ability, can any player who has controlled a permanent with hideaway since then look at that card?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: any player who has controlled a permanent with a hideaway ability since the card was exiled with it may look at it.
expected.answer: Any player who has controlled a permanent with a hideaway ability since a card was exiled with it may look at that card.

whyHard: The card is exiled face down, so players think only the player who exiled it can ever look.
